WITH project_counts AS (
  SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS qc_count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY arcref
), shares AS (
  SELECT arcref,
         qc_count,
         1.0 * qc_count / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM project_counts
)
SELECT arcref,
       qc_count,
       share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS deviation
FROM shares
ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
